summary: A positively finished game now uses a prepared search connection after an explicit click. It sends one HTTP quit, waits for Response.ok, rechecks current intent, then sends start_game_search before navigating in the same tab.
eligibility: Postgame feature and skip-confirm enabled; positive finished-game state and a consistent game id.
Foreground tab, explicit button click and no newer trusted input.
Fresh cross-tab live-match check before quit and before starting search.
Viewer/eliminated-only state, stream windows, missing identity, manual confirmation and cold connections retain the existing page flow.

navigationCheckpoints.pending: No quit authorized; the existing page flow may continue.
navigationCheckpoints.quitting: Quit may have reached the server. A new document never retries quit or automatically starts search; it asks the user to continue manually.
navigationCheckpoints.search: HTTP quit acknowledged; a new document may resume search, but never repeat quit.
navigationCheckpoints.queued: Search acknowledged; reconnect may accept a server-confirmed newly assigned game.

failureHandling: Double click does not duplicate quit; HTTP errors, network errors and the 8-second quit timeout never retry quit.
Cancellation invalidates pending authorization, fetch, socket retry and late results.
New game identity, changed settings or newer trusted input stop the current intent.
Pagehide invalidates the transport readiness retained by BFCache; persisted checkpoints survive normal navigation.

validation.rolesPrivacy: 17 DOM regressions passed; fake, hidden, pinned and peeked roles cannot leak through panel text, probabilities or diagnostics

measurement.method: Offline deterministic tests with a fake clock and controlled HTTP/socket replies; not measurements of the live service.
measurement.meaning: The prepared path has no fixed page-load or 8-second settle delay after the successful quit response. Real time also includes server responses, cross-tab authorization and browser scheduling.
loggedIntervals: HTTP success to each search request
click to first search request, latest search request and search acknowledgement
measurement.priorityAfterRefresh: not verified on a live authenticated session
